title: Shift + Drag for FancyZones doesn't work for new version of ChatGPT Desktop client

judgment.rationale: The report identifies the PowerToys and ChatGPT versions, and a maintainer says the same app/build works on another machine. The author supplied Windows 11 Enterprise build 22631 and an HP Elite x360, but there is no comparison with another window, confirmation of the Shift+drag setting or app elevation, or capture showing whether the zone overlay appears. Current code already includes a merged Shift-state re-seed for elevated foreground/RDP input loss, so no speculative duplicate fix is justified.
judgment.recommended_action: Acknowledge the useful version and OS details. Request the narrow comparison that distinguishes an app-specific window path from a global FancyZones/input configuration: confirm Shift+drag setting and ChatGPT elevation, test Notepad in the same layout, note overlay visibility, and attach a short recording of one ChatGPT drag.
evidence: The current issue body reports PowerToys 0.102.2933.0 and ChatGPT Desktop 26.1021.31345; ChatGPT Classic had worked previously.
A maintainer reports Shift+drag works with PowerToys 0.102.2933.0 and ChatGPT 26.1021.31345 on another machine. The reporter then supplies Windows 11 Enterprise build 22631 on an HP Elite x360 830.
The attachment in the discussion is a 'works on my machine' meme, not a screenshot or recording of the reported behavior.

Current upstream FancyZones DraggingState seeds Shift state at drag start; the behavior was added by merged PR #49926 for stale input state when an elevated foreground window or detached/RDP input path prevents raw Shift transitions.
No exact duplicate, candidate fix PR, or fork issue/PR mirror was found.

fix_assessment.rationale: No new PowerToys code fix is justified from the current one-app report. Upstream already contains the merged Shift-state re-seed for known elevated/RDP input-state loss, but the current evidence does not show that this report is the same failure or that FancyZones has a reproducible defect with this ChatGPT build. Obtain the missing comparison before assigning any further code change.

issue_context.summary: Shift+dragging a window does not snap the new ChatGPT Desktop client (26.1021.31345) into a FancyZones zone on PowerToys 0.102.2933.0; ChatGPT Classic reportedly worked previously.
known_information: The issue is open and has Issue-Bug, Product-FancyZones, and Needs-Triage labels.
The maintainer reports the same PowerToys and ChatGPT versions work on another machine.
The reporter uses Windows 11 Enterprise build 22631 on an HP Elite x360 830.
The reporter has not stated whether Shift+drag is enabled, whether ChatGPT runs elevated, or whether a control application such as Notepad snaps in the same layout.
The discussion attachment is a meme and contains no app screenshot, zone overlay, or reproduction evidence.

Upstream PR #49926 is merged; current source includes its Shift-state re-seed at drag start. The existing canonical PR review artifact is review_ready but predates the merge and is not a current issue disposition.
inferences: Because another maintainer succeeds with the same app and PowerToys versions, a configuration or environment difference is plausible, but the discussion does not isolate one.
If Notepad snaps but ChatGPT does not, an app-specific window/input path becomes more likely; the available evidence does not identify a cause.
issue_context.analysis: The original report has a useful basic reproduction, but a second-machine comparison now shows the failure is not universal. The thread still lacks the settings state, elevation state, control-app result, and visible overlay behavior needed to decide whether the issue is an app-specific window path or a local input/configuration difference. The upstream merged Shift-state fix is already present and is relevant context, not proof that this report is fixed. Ask for a short, specific comparison rather than logs or a competing implementation proposal.
initial_investigation: Read the complete current issue body and all comments, labels, and the discussion attachment. The only attachment is a 'works on my machine' meme; no reporter screenshot or recording is attached.

Reviewed current upstream FancyZones DraggingState.cpp and FancyZones::MoveSizeStart. Shift state is read at drag start; Shift+drag state is computed from the configured setting and current key state.

Reviewed merged PR #49926, which re-seeds Shift state at drag start for known stale-state cases involving elevated foreground input, secure desktop, or RDP attach/detach. Current upstream source contains that change.
Searched upstream issue/PR records for ChatGPT/FancyZones and checked canonical and fork traces; no exact duplicate, fix PR, fork mirror, or current canonical issue artifact found.

information_gaps.information: Whether FancyZones Shift+drag is enabled, whether ChatGPT is running elevated, and whether Notepad snaps in the same layout
information_gaps.why_needed: These checks distinguish a global FancyZones/input configuration issue from a ChatGPT-specific window/input behavior and determine whether the existing elevated-input Shift-state path is relevant.
information_gaps.how_to_collect: Check FancyZones settings for Shift+drag, note whether ChatGPT was launched with Run as administrator, and try dragging a Notepad title bar with Shift held using the same monitor and layout.

information_gaps.information: Whether the FancyZones zone overlay appears while holding Shift and dragging the ChatGPT title bar
information_gaps.why_needed: Overlay visibility distinguishes failure to enter the zone-drag state from a later zone selection or drop issue.
information_gaps.how_to_collect: Record a short screen video showing the configured Shift+drag setting and one failed attempt dragging ChatGPT by its title bar with Shift held; include whether zone highlights appear.

actions.label: Request a ChatGPT and Notepad Shift-drag comparison

comment.body:
Thanks, the PowerToys/ChatGPT versions and Windows/HP details are useful; another maintainer reports the same app and PowerToys builds work on their machine. Could you please:
1. Confirm FancyZones Shift+drag is enabled and whether ChatGPT was launched as administrator.
2. Try Shift+dragging a Notepad title bar in the same layout and report whether it snaps.
3. Say whether the zone overlay appears while holding Shift and dragging ChatGPT by its title bar.
A short screen recording showing the setting and one failed ChatGPT attempt would help distinguish a global input/configuration difference from app-specific behavior.
